# [Mandatory] KBYG Snowflake NYC
Date: 2026-10-08 | Duration: 27m

## Summary
The team finalized preparations for the Snowflake World Tour on May 15 at Javits Center, with Growth Book at booth 40 on level three. Lindsey Berens will lead setup, scanning, coordination, and post-event lead export, while the team will arrive for registration at 7:30am before the 8am start. The booth will use a kiosk, demo station, and branded banner, with materials shipped back to the warehouse after teardown. Lead goals include 100 scans, about 40% high-value ICP leads, eight booth demos, four live bookings, and 12 post-event ICP meetings. A single scanner will be supported by badge or LinkedIn photos, and leads will be segmented as hot, warm, nurture, or cold. Calendly QR codes will enable immediate bookings. Snow Cash bills valued at $125 will be reserved for attendees taking demos or booking meetings. The team will use Slack, an event playbook, matching purple apparel, coordinated booth coverage, and timely expense submissions.

## Keywords
Snowflake World Tour, booth staffing, swag distribution, lead scanning, demo booking, snow cash

## Action Items

**Lyndsie Berens**
Share Calendly links for Emmy and Lyndsie with the team before the event to facilitate on-site demo bookings (21:30)
Arrange delivery of purple Growth Book shirts for late additions such as Scott, shipping them to the hotel or an alternate address to ensure timely arrival (09:14)
Act as on-site lead to manage booth setup, lead scanning, and team interactions during the event (06:29)
Monitor snow cash distribution closely, ensuring it is given only to high-value prospects or those booking demos, and prevent distribution to general swag seekers or 'swag hoarders' (14:31)
Collect and export lead data after scanning during the event for follow-up and analysis (19:40)
Collect and compile event expense reports submitted by team members and finalize event expenses for reimbursement processing (23:25)
Coordinate post-event sharing of photos taken during the event for social media promotion and internal use (24:34)

**Liz Fox**
Provide final confirmation details on breakfast and lunch availability at the event to the team once received from the vendor (06:29)
Print and provide shipping labels for returning swag to the Growth Book warehouse using the company UPS account (12:44)
Create and share a Slack channel dedicated to event communication and support for the team (06:29)

**Cary Rakin**
Serve as part of the demo team at the booth and support logistics as required during the event (02:44)
Provide feedback on swag conditions upon arrival, particularly regarding the lip balm issue due to heat susceptibility (03:51)

**Logan Bates**
Assist with demo sessions and booth staffing alongside Cary, and bring swag items including the problematic lip balm for assessment (02:44)

**Scott Keller**
Enforce the selective distribution of snow cash, reserving it for qualifying prospects and those booking demos, to prevent misuse by general swag seekers (14:31)

**All Team Members**
Take and share photos during the event for social media and post-event promotion (24:34)
Bring Calendly QR codes on phones or have them available for booking meetings at the booth to facilitate immediate demo scheduling (20:50)
Dress in Growth Book purple shirts or quarter zips as part of the dress code; contact Lyndsie if missing a shirt to arrange one (07:53)
